body: TARGETED RECHECK OF NEW OFF-TREE DIGEST c6fe6f17a23e9ce7fe938df79f5fc00fc100fb3e8e6ee5e8563f348931a4745b (55,625 bytes, stable after rescan): the second-pass disposition remains AMEND. All five points are still open in this digest. (1) AcquisitionAccount.source is unconditional SourceIdentities; result wire source is only constructed and scientificArtifacts still shows unconditional original/canonical refs, with no Produced/Failed/causal-NotAttempted source-stage branches. (2) 7.3 and 7.4.1 still forbid semantic_model on every Partial branch despite current StoryModelCodec canonically encoding Draft; this remains an explicit policy decision, not a codec limitation. (3) 11.1 still writes manifest last and immediately renames without re-reading exact manifest bytes, canonical-decode validation, and precommit external BundleId computation; post-commit discovery semantics remain unstated. (4) section 8 still lists single-root precedents but no deterministic mixed/composite derivation or typed refusal. (5) 4.2 permits independent preview.txt failure while 10.5 requires textual equivalence, but it does not say Produced HTML is lawful in that case only when the complete textual twin is in-document. The prior detailed review and codec evidence remain controlling; this post only binds them to the new digest. No public-name or implementation adoption.
